rich_narrative.summary: The Morocco Foundation works to fight illiteracy and poverty in rural Moroccan communities through education and themed medical caravans <cite id="1">according to Charity Navigator</cite>. In FY2025, the organization reported a total revenue of $76,622 to support its programs <cite id="2">in IRS Form 990 filings</cite>. The organization delivers direct services at a low cost of $8.15 per beneficiary <cite id="1">based on programmatic records</cite>. Operating as an emerging entity, it provides a direct service delivery model that serves thousands of individuals in underserved areas <cite id="1">as detailed on Charity Navigator</cite>. Giving methods include options for direct sadaqah contributions <cite id="3">via the official website</cite>.
